purpose: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define REST services as named listener instances with stable logical identity separate from configurable port/listen binding and runtime state. [2] Define REST services using the same named-instance model as other listeners, with stable logical identity separate from configurable port/listener binding and explicit route-to-operation mappings.

value.authority_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] REST route existence never bypasses AccessCore/IAM/operation authority. [2] HTTP reachability never substitutes for AccessCore authorization.
value.identity_rule: Each REST service has an explicit stable logical instance identity.
value.instance_rule: Each REST instance has an explicit stable logical name/identity.
value.listener_rule: REST instance binds to an exact named listener.
value.method_rule: HTTP method semantics are explicit per route.
value.payload_rule: Request/response schema and content profile are explicit.
value.port_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] REST port is configurable; no universal default REST port is locked. [2] No universal default REST port is assumed unless explicitly configured.
value.route_rule: REST routes map to exact canonical resources/operations.
value.runtime_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] declared, enabled and running states remain separate. [2] Start/stop/reload changes runtime state without changing REST instance identity.
value.surface_rule: REST routes expose explicitly bound canonical operations/resources.
